name: PolyAI
tagline: Lifelike enterprise voice AI agents for customer service calls.
description: PolyAI's Agentic Dialog Platform builds voice agents that resolve customer service calls for large enterprises in banking, healthcare, hospitality, telecom, and retail. Agent Studio gives non-technical teams a no-code builder while the ADK exposes developer APIs, with SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, and PCI DSS compliance built in. Its proprietary Raven model is trained on over a billion enterprise conversations.
insight: Spun out of Cambridge's Machine Intelligence Lab in 2017; a Dec 2025 Series D valued it at $750M, with Nvidia's NVentures backing.

modelSupport.notes: Proprietary Raven model trained on 1B+ enterprise conversations.

edge: An end-to-end managed contact-center agent on its own Raven model — not a developer toolkit you assemble from telephony, LLM, and TTS parts.

references.title: Call center chatbot startup PolyAI raises $86M at a $750M valuation
